cues.text: Most people think the appendix is a totally useless left-over part.
But that little pouch actually plays a vital hidden role in your immune health.
See that small tube tucked at the base of the large intestine?
That is your appendix, a narrow finger-like pouch tucked away from the main rush of digesting food.
Now look closely at the zoomed inset on the right.
Inside its walls, away from the fast food stream, it keeps a thriving safe house of your microbiome.
Look at the left panel showing the gut after a severe stomach bug.
When an infection sweeps through your digestive system, it often flushes out most of your helpful microbes.
Now look across to the right panel.
Safe inside its narrow pouch, the stored bacteria survive, pouring out to quickly restock and heal your gut.
Your appendix is far from useless.
By acting as a shielded shelter for helpful microbes, it ensures your gut can always recover and thrive.
